A global community united by a shared purpose
International Schools Partnership (ISP) is a leading and growing group of 121 private international schools operating in more than 26 markets and educating 118,000 students worldwide.

We place our students at the centre of their learning journeys. Supported by passionate and experienced educators, they acquire the confidence, knowledge and skills to be successful now and in the future.

ISP’s vision, purpose and principles are seamlessly integrated with each school’s unique strengths, ensuring learners receive a world-class education while staying deeply connected to their local communities.

We want all our students to improve their academic, personal, social and emotional learning in a safe, caring and inclusive atmosphere. Our Learning Pillars approach guarantees continuous improvement across the following five areas for our students.
At ISP, every student gets a personalised education that drives growth and unlocks their true potential.
Master the world’s languages while embracing your own.
Our students become fluent in at least one other global language, as well as their own, preparing them to thrive in an interconnected world.
At ISP, students build the critical skills they need to succeed in school, their careers and their personal lives.
Learning experiences that shape global citizens.
Our international programmes challenge students to think critically, collaborate and lead with confidence in a global context.
Explore, discover and shape your future.
We empower students to find their passions and strengths, giving them the tools to develop the life skills to navigate their academic and career journeys.

In a rapidly evolving world, life competencies are essential for success. Through intentional and repeated learning experiences, our students develop the life skills that empower them to thrive well beyond their time at school.

Our international opportunities connect ISP students worldwide through enriching beyond-the-classroom experiences. Each programme offers students a platform to explore their interests and further develop their global competencies.

We believe in the transformative power of EdTech. By integrating innovative tools and AI, we empower teachers to guide and support students. Our responsible approach ensures that technology enhances, never replaces, the human touch, creating a future of personalised, engaging learning for all.

We recognise the urgent need for environmental action. Our sustainability strategy addresses emissions, plastics and recycling, engaging the entire school community: families, school leaders and teachers. By fostering a culture of shared responsibility, we empower our students to take meaningful actions and shape a sustainable future for generations to come.

pages.title: Our vision, purpose & principles - International Schools Partnership
blocks: “Together, we’re on a journey to deliver a transformative education for our students that sparks their curiosity, grows their self-confidence and nurtures the knowledge and life skills they need to thrive now and throughout their lifetime.”
Steve Brown Group Chief Executive Officer
We exist to grow the world’s most curious, confident minds.
We instil in all students our five core student values: curiosity, open-mindedness, care, confidence and responsibility.
We empower our students to learn to levels that amaze them.
We equip students to be successful now and later.
We help our students to positively participate in an increasingly interconnected world.
We are the first choice for students and their parents, wherever we are.
We begin with our students. Our children and students are at the heart of our business. Simply, their success is our success.
We treat everyone with care and respect. We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the wellbeing of each other.
We operate effectively. We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference.
We are financially responsible. We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of our children, students and schools.
We learn continuously. Getting better is what drives us.

pages.title: Who and where we are - International Schools Partnership
blocks: International Schools Partnership (ISP) is a leading and growing group of 121 private international schools operating in more than 26 markets and educating 118,000 students worldwide.

Our role at ISP is to support and enable our schools to become the schools of choice in their local communities and the global education sector. We strive to grow schools renowned for setting new standards of excellence in education, cultivating future-ready students and enriching the communities they serve.
Steve Brown Group Chief Executive Officer
ISP was founded by a small team of experienced leaders in international education.
ISP takes its first major step, acquiring Colegios Laude in Spain
ISP welcomes its first schools in the Middle East and Mexico , broadening its global reach.
ISP launches International Learning Opportunities (ILOS) . Today 40,000+ students participated in ISP international opportunities in 2025/26!
Schools in the US Malaysia , and the UK join ISP for the first time. We also open our first greenfield school in the Middle East
The Learning Hub , ISP’s dedicated learning platform, is launched—offering 80+ courses to support professional development.
ISP expands further into South America, welcoming new schools in Colombia Ecuador and Chile
ISP introduces its proprietary ‘Learning Improvement Process’ (‘LIP’) , which progressively improves student learning and academic achievement’.
ISP expands into India and launches the LabSchool initiative —our hubs for educational innovation.
ISP is recognised as a Provider of Training Excellence by CPD. We also welcome new schools in Poland Brazil the Dominican Republic Panama and Thailand
ISP launches the AI Toolbox , a bespoke suite of AI tools designed to enhance teacher productivity and personalise learning.
A landmark year as ISP reached 121 schools , serving over 118,000 students worldwide.
